Procedural amendments logged during V6 (V6 NOTES section 7): (1) reference ranking, before the reference was selected: candidates ranked by atlas E100 corrected for the family's median search-tier error instead of raw atlas E100; A4 unchanged; (2) size-effect ratio, after the first design macro run: the size-effect ratio is taken against the cell's own C* at the same n (the first estimator mixed in discretization bias); A2s is a reported flag, A2 unaffected; (3) STL re-voxelization anti-aliasing, after the first static rows of the design recheck, before any recheck verdict: binary ray-parity samples replaced by anti-aliased fractions; the aborted run is kept; (4) case-1 sessions rerun under one code identity, after all case-1 results existed: sessions, macro and recheck rerun under code f1a6d625064a6d18; old runs archived; chains kept; (5) shared GPU lock, a lock defect let processes overlap; numbers unaffected (replays exact), but timings before about 09:40 are inflated by contention.\par
Flags (reported, not verdicts): mount design: erosion by 0.01 a fails (E100 54.4 MPa); mount reference: erosion by 0.01 a fails (E100 48.2 MPa); filter 316L: dilation by 0.01 a fails (gap counts fail). The PA12 filter fails manufacturing screening: min solid 0.74 mm < 0.8 mm SLS limit. Screening is not a printability claim.\par
Chain: 6 cells along [001], periodic in x and y (normal incidence only), hysteretic η = 0.01, rigid bonded input plate, free output face. In-band levels below about -60 dB have no practical meaning beyond strongly attenuated; only the -20 dB comparison is claimed.\par
Mount stiffness: homogenized block with the guarded C* (lower E100, lower G, worst $\nu$100); requirement 7.2 kN/mm (0.25 mm under 1.8 kN). Axial load only; no shear, buckling, creep or strength check.\par
Times: case-2 and first case-1 timings were inflated by contention with V2 (V6 NOTES deviation 5); the case-1 rows are the rerun under code f1a6d625064a6d18.\par
Released rules (amm 0.2.0, after the V6 run): re-judged from the stored solves (results/verification/v14/engineering.json), the PA12 filter has no safe upper edge and the 316L bars span 2.4 voxels at n = 40, so both are undetermined; the finer gap check (counted n = 30 and 40, edges at n = 60; results/verification/v15/filters.json, re-judged in results/verification/v19/rejudge.json) gives PA12 certified and 316L certified. The mount certificates hold.
